quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign shape and color mean?
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign only means no passing zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for any vehicles or pedestrians to clear before going.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about unusual or dangerous conditions in work areas. This sign means construction work is ahead and you should slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that the road ahead curves and you should adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a low ground railroad crossing. The railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle and low vehicles may get stuck or dragged on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. Turn around and find a different route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is ahead and you should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must or must not do. This sign means you cannot park here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a sharp curve ahead. The chevron points in the direction of the curve. You may see several of these signs placed along the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching.
Come to a full stop, then go when it is safe.
Proceed carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on a crossing road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. You must let vehicles and pedestrians in the intersection pass first. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. If your left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing up, it means you plan to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What should you worry about most when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may not work correctly if one side of your vehicle is higher.
You could damage a tire by drifting onto the shoulder.
You could hydroplane if water is on the shoulder.
You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If a wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or steer sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (in this case, 13 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the divided highway is about to end.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes very slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road turns sharply right, then left.
The road turns sharply left, then right.
The road curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that you are coming to an intersection. Watch carefully for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers of upcoming hazards. This sign tells you a traffic light is ahead. Be ready to stop for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a roundabout is ahead. Drive slowly into the roundabout and let traffic already in it go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that right turns are not allowed. You must follow this rule.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This round sign warns you of a railroad crossing ahead. Watch for trains and be ready to stop.

questions.question: On the freeway, you see a "Merging traffic" sign. You should:

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: Make room for vehicles entering from other lanes. If safe, move over one lane to let them in.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride next to traffic. Drive slowly and carefully in this area because bicycles are common here.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with their palm down and swings it down, the group of riders should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop and let traffic go first. You may proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead is very low.
Two lanes of traffic moving opposite ways are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead is very low.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the overpass ahead is low. Do not drive if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet, 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does it mean when the lead rider raises their left arm and points one finger?

options.text: Ride in a single line, one behind the other.
The group will exit at the next opportunity.

questions.correctAnswerText: Ride in a single line, one behind the other.
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders in groups communicate. When the lead rider raises their left arm and points one finger, it tells all riders to get into a single-file line.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must drive at the speed shown.
The highest legal speed allowed is 55 mph.
You must drive through the intersection at this speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed allowed is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the fastest speed you may drive on this road. In rain, snow, ice, or bad conditions, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and get ready to stop.
Stop completely, then go only if it is safe.
Drive carefully through the intersection. You may not need to stop.
Stop only if there is traffic from another road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go only if it is safe.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must always stop completely. Only move forward when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and use your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stay on the side the arrow points to.
You can drive in the left lane.
You have the right of way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay on the side the arrow points to.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. It warns that an island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must keep to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They get drivers ready for hazards ahead. This sign alerts you to an upcoming curve in the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
A divided highway is starting. Slow down to 35 mph.
Merge ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
The road winds ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves to the right. You must slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks can use the bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead has one-way traffic only.
Only one car can cross the bridge at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that a bridge is coming up that may be too narrow to safely pass a truck. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you traffic only moves in one direction on this street. You must drive the way the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to stop for a red light or watch for cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: The red circle with a red slash means the action is not allowed. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: When you see a yield sign, you should:

options.text: Always come to a complete stop.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let traffic in the intersection pass before you enter.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to keep to the right side of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you that left turns are not permitted at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead. Watch for people on foot.

questions.question: This is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means "Yield." Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and oncoming vehicles go first. Stop only if needed.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: This sign tells you that:

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road has three or more curves coming up.

questions.question: This sign is a warning that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a railroad crossing ahead. Slow down and let trains pass. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people crossing and be ready to stop.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: This sign is used to warn drivers:

options.text: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane is ending. Move to the left lane.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed for exiting a highway. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign with white background and black markings. Drivers must obey all regulatory signs. You cannot pass other vehicles where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign warns you about a steep hill coming up. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead is divided. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill section is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells drivers to yield when turning left on a green light. You must let oncoming traffic pass before you complete your turn.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in a group. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm up and swings it upward, it tells riders to go faster.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This regulatory sign shows a law you must follow. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, whether there's a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must let pedestrians cross safely. Watch carefully at intersections and be ready to stop for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign warns that a steep hill is coming. Slow down and be ready to adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the road is wet.
The road ahead has many curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Reduce your speed, avoid sudden braking or steering, and keep more distance from the car ahead.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Left arm extended straight out to the side means a left turn or left lane change. Use hand signals when your turn signals do not work.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed. Do not turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A sign with a red circle and red slash means the action is prohibited. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic only moves in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic only moves in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic must flow in the direction of the arrow only.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits only.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
This lane is for buses and cars with two or more people.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits only.
questions.explanation: This sign marks spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits only.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead makes a sharp right turn followed by a sharp left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers to stay on the right side to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: In group riding, what does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight down with palm facing back, all riders should stop.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is coming.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns that traffic may merge from the right. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane is ending.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns that traffic may enter from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
Operators may turn left or continue straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you must either turn right or go straight.

questions.question: A yellow and black diamond-shaped sign:

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background. They tell you about conditions on or near the road ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves right and then left ahead. Slow down to safely drive through these curves.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns of a T intersection ahead where you may need to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are not allowed on the upcoming hill.
Trucks are on the upcoming hill.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians are walking along the road ahead.
Watch for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing ahead. Slow down and watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells drivers the road may be slippery when wet. Drive slowly and carefully in these conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that you are leaving a divided highway and entering a road where traffic moves in both directions.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed in all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road when conditions are ideal. You must drive slower if weather, traffic, or road conditions are poor.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction will soon become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you not to enter because traffic on this road flows in only one direction, and you are facing the wrong way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road is crossing a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road is crossing a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads divided by a median or guard rail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Three-sided signs tell you to slow down at an intersection and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and diamond-shaped. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign tells you a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must or must not do. This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for hazards ahead. This sign tells you the area has low clearance above the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for hazards ahead. This sign warns you that traffic is coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A volunteer group is picking up trash on the highway ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a crosswalk for pedestrians ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers are on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for hazards ahead. This sign warns you that bicycles may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. They prepare you for hazards ahead. This sign tells you a lane is ending. Get ready to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: A divided highway is starting ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roads with a median between them. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead where another road crosses.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is ahead. A road will join from the right side.

questions.question: What must you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: Any eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop. Look for pedestrians and other vehicles. Only go when the intersection is clear.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: A triangular sign means yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road will curve right first, then curve left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This marks a HOV (high occupancy vehicle) lane. Only buses and vehicles with the required number of passengers can use this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped, yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic signal (traffic light) is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for what is coming. This sign warns that a stop sign is ahead. Get ready to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What is the correct order of colors on a traffic light from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: On vertical traffic lights, red is always on top and green is always on the bottom. On horizontal traffic lights, red is always on the left and green is always on the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is a sharp right turn coming up on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is coming.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At a yield sign, slow down as you approach. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that bicycles may be in the area.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a four-way intersection is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road will curve to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.

Come to a complete stop before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you pass this sign, you are going the wrong way and risk a head-on crash. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: When a driver's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing up, what does it mean?

options.text: The driver plans to turn left.
The driver is about to stop.
The driver plans to turn right.
The driver is about to slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: The driver plans to turn right.
questions.explanation: Drivers can use hand signals instead of turn signals. When the left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing up, it means the driver plans to turn right or move to the right lane.
